repair.content:
With original margin >=m and pairwise projected error differences <=rho, a_hat_i >=1/(1+(S-1)exp(-m+rho)). Bound proved; only conditional single-head guarantee, no full-model or prompt-independent result.

Removing layers 22, 24, and 25 from Qwen32 group index 2 gives a complete, disjoint 64-layer partition compatible with the templates; this data-level repair was verified. Sum the distinct-layer mapping to avoid cost duplicates; performance remains unverified.
